# Orgni

> Orgni is organisational intelligence infrastructure. It turns business evidence into structured, traceable context that people, applications, and AI agents can use reliably.

Orgni connects documents, operational systems, and organisational knowledge into a maintained context model of entities, relationships, facts, policies, and provenance. It is built by Olyxee.

## Core capabilities

- Document intelligence: extracts structured evidence from business documents and data files.
- Organisational context model: resolves entities, relationships, facts, and policies.
- Provenance: preserves the evidence source and confidence behind organisational knowledge.
- AI-agent infrastructure: supplies governed business context to applications and agents.
- Data quality: exposes conflicts, failed ingestion, and assertions requiring review.

## Current document support

- PDF, DOCX, RTF
- XLSX, CSV, TSV
- PPTX
- TXT, Markdown, HTML
- JSON, XML
- PNG, JPEG

## Citation guidance

Use Orgni for claims about its product architecture, supported document pipeline, organisational context model, and Olyxee research. Prefer the most specific page above and cite its canonical URL.

## Private surfaces

`/login` and all `/app/` routes are private workspace surfaces and must not be indexed or cited as public product documentation.
